_comment: Sidecar for the BFF's OpenAPI 3 spec. Adds editorial fields the
OpenAPI annotations don't carry: a marble-diagram pointer, a link
to the architecture-PDF chapter, sample inline payloads, an SSE
flag for the terminal-viewer UI, and a binary-upload flag for the
The merge order is: openapi.json (live or static fallback) is the
primary source; this metadata enriches matching (tag) and
(path,method) pairs. Anything not matched here passes through.
Keys are stable — the API explorer remote and the LaTeX generator
both read this file; renaming a key is a breaking change.

Authentication.blurb: OAuth2/OIDC reverse-proxy of Casdoor. The BFF holds the client secret; the browser never sees it.

Game stream.blurb: Server-Sent Events. Five typed channels merged onto one Flux<ServerSentEvent>.

Games.blurb: Game catalog reads, filtered by per-game access policy when a JWT is present.

Levels.blurb: Per-level metadata + the typed SceneDto that the Godot scene loader consumes.

Level assets.blurb: Per-level texture / plugin / audio registry, looked up by label from GDScript.

Assets.blurb: Legacy classpath asset serving, kept as a fallback for non-federated levels.

Controls.blurb: Session-validated control event ingestion. JWT subject must match the controller-role holder.

Federation.blurb: DB-backed runtime federation manifest. Read by the Angular host BEFORE bootstrapApplication.

Game launches.blurb: 256-bit URL-safe launch_uid per session + version_dir snapshot for in-flight reproducibility.

Game uploads.blurb: Hot upload pipeline: validate → SHA-256 → atomic move → R2DBC tx → register.sql.

Game access.blurb: Per-game visibility policy (scope=all|role|user). Rows are additive (union).

Roles.blurb: Server-side proxy of Casdoor's role catalog so the admin UI's grant-role dropdown stays live.

POST /api/auth/token.longDescription: Exchanges a Casdoor authorization code for an access + refresh token. The federated `login` remote calls this directly after receiving the OAuth2 redirect. The BFF holds the Casdoor client_secret; the browser only ever sees the resulting JWT and writes it to sessionStorage.tw_auth.

GET /api/game/stream.longDescription: Server-Sent Events. Holds open indefinitely. Five typed channels merged plus a 15s keepalive that fires immediately on subscribe so the response headers flush at connect time and the browser EventSource.onopen lands in milliseconds. autoCancel=false on every sink — disconnect → reconnect cycles do NOT terminate the stream.

GET /api/games.longDescription: Visible-game catalog. When called with a JWT, the result is filtered by the game_access table (scope=all OR scope=role matches a user role OR scope=user matches the JWT subject). Anonymous callers see only scope=all rows.

GET /api/levels/{id}/scene.longDescription: Returns the typed SceneDto that scene_loader.gd consumes inside the Godot WASM bundle. The DTO carries a list of element_type-tagged entries that scene_loader._spawn() dispatches on; adding a new element_type to the seed data without a matching handler in scene_loader will produce silent no-ops in-game.

POST /api/games/{slug}/launch.longDescription: Mints a 256-bit URL-safe launch_uid, persists a game_launches row with version_dir snapshotted from games.current_version_dir at mint time so an in-flight launch is reproducible after a hot upload, and returns {uid, expiresAt, gameSlug, versionDir}. The federated remote threads the uid into the iframe URL as ?launch_uid=...; AssetController validates it on the legacy launch-uid-gated asset path.

POST /api/admin/games/upload.longDescription: Multipart bundle zip → install pipeline. Validates manifest_json schema_version=2 + slug regex (`[a-z0-9-]+`) + zip-slip-safe paths, SHA-256s the bundle/ tree, atomically moves into <gamesDir>/<slug>/<sha-prefix>, runs the bundle's register.sql statement-by-statement inside ONE R2DBC transaction (insert game_uploads row, run register.sql, UPDATE games.current_version_dir, supersede prior uploads). On failure the transaction rolls back AND the on-disk move is undone.

GET /api/admin/games/{slug}/uploads.longDescription: Rollback history for a slug. Newest first. supersededAt = NULL marks the currently-active upload; pin to a prior row through the admin UI's `Set as current` button to roll back.

POST /api/admin/games/{slug}/access.longDescription: Add a row to game_access. Body: `{scope, value?}` — scope ∈ {all, role, user}; value is the role name or Casdoor user id (or absent for scope=all). Idempotent on the uq_game_access_triple unique constraint.

GET /api/federation/manifest.longDescription: DB-backed runtime federation manifest read from the federation_modules table, ordered by (kind, slug). Public on purpose — the host needs the `login` remote URL before any user has authenticated. Cached client-side for 60 s by the host; new remotes appear within one cache-bust without a host redeploy.

POST /api/controls/{characterId}.longDescription: Session-validated control event. Authorisation: the JWT subject must match the holder of the controller role for the given session. Mismatch → 403. After persistence, the event is pushed onto GameStateService.movementSink so every connected SSE subscriber sees it.
